seed_data.title: Gentle Silk Cleanser

snapshot.title: Gentle Silk Cleanser

variants.description:
100ml 

The Gentle Silk Cleanser is a daily cleansing formula enriched with the proprietary Hydrolysed Silk Complex HSC01-A™ and glycerin to purify the skin while preserving its essential lipids. Designed to respect the skin’s natural barrier, it removes impurities, environmental residue, and excess oil without disturbing the skin’s optimum hydration equilibrium.

Its lightweight, feather-soft texture transforms on contact with water, emulsifying into a milky fluid that rinses away effortlessly. The result is a complexion that feels clean, comfortable, and prepared for exfoliation.

BENEFITS
Immediately: Skin is refreshed, softened, and hydrated. With continued use: Skin appears smoother, more balanced, and visibly more radiant.

Dermatologically tested and approved. Patch test before application.
Approved under the Leaping Bunny programme.

Using fingertips, massage the Gentle Silk Cleanser into the face in circular motions until a creamy texture forms.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Hero ingredients
pdp_details_sections.body:
HSC-01A™ 0.5% & Glycerin 4%
HSC-01A™ undergoes a precise lab hydrolysis process which unlocks a rare blend of di- and tripeptides alongside silk's native 18 free amino acids. Sharing a 90% rate of affinity with the human skin and echoing its natural-moisturising factors, these amino acids rebuild the intercellular lipid matrix, while bioactive peptides prompt fibroblasts to support elasticity for a renewed and youthful appearance.
This process results in an elevated protein content of 2.52% - more than double that of hydrolysed silk alternatives - delivering a significantly higher concentration of glycine, serine, alanine, and other amino acids known to maintain moisture, stimulate collagen synthesis, and support elasticity.
Within the HSC-01A™:
Peptides act as cellular messengers, stimulating collagen production and reinforcing structural integrity.
Free amino acids such as serine, arginine, and glycine contribute to long-lasting hydration, improved tone, and strengthened skin resilience.
The predominance of tripeptides, each with a molecular weight of ~300 Da, ensures excellent skin penetration for targeted regeneration and visible results.

The HSC-01A™ amino acid profile is optimised for consistency and protein concentration. The result: a refined, performance-focused active that works across all layers of the skin, delivering hydration, structure, and glow - with every...

Within the HSC-01A™:

Peptides act as cellular messengers, stimulating collagen production and reinforcing structural integrity.

Free amino acids such as serine, arginine, and glycine contribute to long-lasting hydration, improved tone, and strengthened skin resilience.

The predominance of tripeptides, each with a molecular weight of ~300 Da, ensures excellent skin penetration for targeted regeneration and visible results.

The HSC-01A™ amino acid profile is optimised for consistency and protein concentration. The result: a refined, performance-focused active that works across all layers of the skin, delivering hydration, structure, and glow - with every application.
